description: Cortical epithelial cells show self-peptides on MHC class I to developing T cells. Those whose receptor binds with the right strength commit to the CD8 line and, after the medulla's checks, leave as naive CD8 T cells. Cortical cells make these peptides with a thymus-specific proteasome (shown mainly in mice). Selection acts on the developing cell, before it is a cytotoxic CD8 T cell.
